title: TaskGraph
description: Every package and task in the workspace, and how the tasks depend on each other, as printed by `vp run --json`.

$schema.description: `file://` URL of the JSON Schema that describes this document.

version.description: Format version. It changes only for a breaking change: a rename, a removal, or a changed meaning. New fields and values don't change it; ignore fields you don't know.

workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path of the workspace root. Other paths are relative to it, with `/` on every platform.

packages.description: Every package in the workspace, keyed by path (`"."` for the root), even ones without tasks.

tasks.description: Every task, keyed by task ID: `<package path>#<task name>`, e.g. `packages/ui#build`, or just the task name for a task of the root package. In each part, `%` is written `%25` and `#` is written `%23`. Compare IDs; don't decode them.

name.description: The name in `package.json`. Absent when the package has none.

dependencies.description: The other workspace packages in `dependencies` in `package.json`, by path. Packages from outside the workspace aren't listed. Absent when there are none.

devDependencies.description: The other workspace packages in `devDependencies` in `package.json`, by path. Packages from outside the workspace aren't listed. Absent when there are none.

peerDependencies.description: The other workspace packages in `peerDependencies` in `package.json`, by path. Packages from outside the workspace aren't listed. Absent when there are none.

package.description: The path of the task's package, which is also its key in `packages`.

name.description: The task name, from `vite.config.*` or a `package.json` script.

cwd.description: The directory the command runs in, when the task's `cwd` setting changes it. It is absolute when it's outside the workspace.

command.description: The command as the task defines it.

dependsOn.description: The tasks in the task's own `dependsOn`, by ID. An entry such as `{ task: 'build', from: 'dependencies' }` is replaced by the tasks it selects. Absent when there are none.
